text: The reviewer reports that the earlier labels neither activate controls nor announce correctly. The author changes the menulist labels to XUL labels with control targets; the final reviewer explicitly reports that labels now work and announce correctly. The assigned source has label control="defaultViewFlags" and label control="defaultSortType". This adds the historical reported correction to the existing structural-label lesson; it is not our screen-reader result. A different nearby apply-to caption becomes html:span because it does not control a field. The requested palette icon is decorative with empty alt next to the separately localized category name. Keep a real control label, contextual caption and decorative image distinct. The fixed threading control is a later radiogroup, while the original landing is a menulist. Partial historical evidence: Bug comments9/10/12/35 unavailable; no new runtime validation.
title: Appearance review distinguishes working control labels from nearby text
